description_en: An API operation that uploads a credential image, such as a utility bill or credit card statement, and uses Qwen-VL to intelligently fetch the billing address and name from the credential
description_zh: API接口，上传凭证图片，包括：水电煤、信用卡账单等，通过通义VL智能提取账单地址及姓名
kebab_example: aliyun cloudauth-intl credential-recognition-intl --product-code CREDENTIAL_RECOGNITION --credential-ocr-picture-base64 base64 --credential-ocr-picture-url https://000 --doc-type 01 --ocr-area 0101 --fraud-check true --region cn-hangzhou
name: CredentialRecognitionIntl

parameters.help_en: The product solution to use. Set this to CREDENTIAL_RECOGNITION
parameters.help_zh: 要接入的产品方案。取值CREDENTIAL_RECOGNITION
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The Base64-encoded image. If you choose to pass in the image by using IdOcrPictureBase64 (Base64-encoded photo), check the photo size and do not pass in an excessively large photo
parameters.help_zh: 图片Base64编码。如果您选择IdOcrPictureBase64（照片Base64编码）方式传入照片，请注意检查照片大小，不要传入过大的照片
parameters.name: credential_ocr_picture_base64

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image. The URL must be a publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS link
parameters.help_zh: 图片地址，公网可访问的HTTP、HTTPS链接
parameters.name: credential_ocr_picture_url

parameters.help_en:
The credential type. Valid values:
01: transaction credential (including electronic bill images for water, electricity, gas, credit cards, and other types)
parameters.help_zh:
凭证类型。
交易凭据：01（包括：水、电、煤、信用卡等各类电子账单图片）
parameters.name: doc_type

parameters.help_en:
The extraction type. Valid values:
0101: electronic bill address and name module (extracts the address and name module through intelligent analysis)
parameters.help_zh:
提取类型：
0101：电子账单地址&姓名模块（通过智能分析提取地址及姓名模块）
parameters.name: ocr_area

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable tampering detection. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启篡改检测
true：开启
false：关闭
parameters.name: fraud_check
